# Tools the playbook needs. Read by install-mac.sh and install-ubuntu.sh, so
# the Mac and Ubuntu installs stay in step: add a tool here, for every route.
# Columns (whitespace separated, - = not available that way):
#   name     command that must be on PATH afterwards (python3 must be >= 3.11)
#   brew     Homebrew formula, or cask:NAME, or tap/formula (install-mac.sh
#            runs `brew trust --formula` for those: Homebrew 7 refuses
#            untrusted tap formulae). python3: `python`, the only formula that
#            links `python3` (python@3.NN does not once it is not the default).
#   port     MacPorts port, or release (release-binaries.txt), or native (vendor installer)
#   apt      Ubuntu package, or repo:NAME (vendor apt repo, see install-ubuntu.sh), or release
# Why each one: git/python3/bash run every script; tmux and workmux run the
# per-card worktrees and the board; gh creates the private hub repos
# (push-hub.sh); gitleaks is the second opinion in the pre-push scan; jq is
# used by agents and the planned settings merge (card 006); claude is the agent.
#
# name     brew                    port        apt
git        git                     git         git
tmux       tmux                    tmux        tmux
jq         jq                      jq          jq
python3    python                  python313   python3
gh         gh                      gh          repo:gh
gitleaks   gitleaks                gitleaks    release
workmux    raine/workmux/workmux   release     release
claude     cask:claude-code        native      repo:claude-code
